verdict.rationale: The Marketing API documents creating a contact for an audience (docs-4) and positions itself around pulling custom data from your app (docs-1). Syncing profile data is referenced, though only via webhooks (docs-30). Suppression is only loosely evidenced through the Transactional API's rejection allowlist/denylist (docs-17), not marketing-audience contacts. Missing for 10: documented contact update/upsert endpoints, explicit custom properties (merge fields) on contacts, marketing-audience suppression/unsubscribe via API, batch/bulk operations and rate-limit evidence for production scale, independent hands-on corroboration.
